# Northeast Damp Proofers

> Independent damp and timber specialists in the North East of England, led by Jeff Webb (PCA Qualified Technician in Damp and Timber, PCAQT, Certificate No. 957) and Dan (based in Durham). Covering Newcastle upon Tyne, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham, Tyneside and Northumberland.

> Northeast Damp Proofers (northeastdampproofers.co.uk, 07446 522034) is an independent business run by Jeff Webb and Dan. It is not connected to any similarly named firm, such as North East Damp Proofing (northeastdampproofing.co.uk).

Phone: 07446 522034
Email: info@northeastdampproofers.co.uk
Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8am–5pm, Saturday 8am–12pm
Website: https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/

## Key facts
- Business name: Northeast Damp Proofers (one word "Northeast", "Proofers"), website northeastdampproofers.co.uk
- Run by: Jeff Webb and Dan (Dan is based in Durham)
- Qualification: Jeff Webb, PCA Qualified Technician in Damp and Timber (PCAQT), Certificate No. 957, awarded by the Property Care Association
- Approach: diagnosis first with moisture readings; treatment only when the cause needs it (no chemical damp-proof course for a gutter, leak or condensation problem)
- Surveys: free no-obligation damp inspection; written damp survey report from £150
- Areas: Newcastle upon Tyne, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham, North Tyneside, South Tyneside and Northumberland
- Not connected to: North East Damp Proofing (northeastdampproofing.co.uk) or any other similarly named firm

## Services
- [All services and "Which service do I need?" guide](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): symptoms mapped to likely causes, plus FAQs. Free damp inspection; written damp survey report from £150
- [Damp surveys and written reports](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#damp-survey-report): moisture readings, diagnosis and a written report
- [Rising damp treatment](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#rising-damp): diagnosis, damp-proof course and re-plastering
- [Penetrating damp](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#penetrating-damp): finding and fixing water ingress
- [Condensation and black mould treatment](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/condensation-black-mould.html): why most black mould in North East homes is condensation, how it is diagnosed with humidity readings, and fixes such as extraction and positive input ventilation (PIV); damp and mould reports for landlords
- [Basement and cellar waterproofing](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html#waterproofing): tanking and membrane systems

## Areas
- [Damp proofing and damp surveys in Newcastle upon Tyne](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-proofing-newcastle.html): Tyneside flats, Victorian terraces, cellars and rented homes across Newcastle
- [Damp proofing and damp surveys in Gateshead](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-proofing-gateshead.html): Tyneside flats in Bensham and Saltwell, Low Fell villas, hillside homes in Whickham and Ryton, and rented homes across Gateshead
- [Damp proofing and damp surveys in Sunderland](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-proofing-sunderland.html): Sunderland cottages, seafront homes in Roker and Seaburn, colliery villages and rented homes across Wearside
- [Damp proofing and damp surveys in Durham](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-proofing-durham.html): Durham City and County Durham

## Blog
- [Damp or mould in a new-build house? Drying out or a defect](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-new-build-house.html): what condensation, shrinkage cracks and damp are normal while a new-build home dries out, the signs of a leak or construction defect, first-winter ventilation tips, and how builder (first two years) and warranty (years 3-10) responsibility and the new-homes complaint routes work
- [Damp came back after replastering? Salts, gypsum and what to do](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-after-replastering-salts.html): why damp returns on newly replastered walls (unfixed water ingress, walls not dried out, hygroscopic chloride and nitrate salts), why gypsum plaster often fails on salty walls, and what to check before replastering again
- [Damp in a Tyneside flat? Upstairs, downstairs and who fixes what](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-tyneside-flat-upstairs-downstairs.html): typical damp causes in ground-floor and first-floor Tyneside flats, damp that crosses between the two flats, and how criss-cross leases usually split repair responsibility
- [Should you block air bricks in winter? Why it can rot your floor](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/blocked-air-bricks-timber-floor.html): why blocking air bricks under a suspended timber floor can cause damp joists, rot and woodworm, what homeowners can check, and better ways to stop draughts
- [Damp patch on a chimney breast? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-chimney-breast.html): why chimney breasts get damp patches and brown stains (rain in the stack, condensation in sealed flues, hygroscopic salts from old coal fires), what to check, and why a damp-proof course won't fix it
- [Damp after cavity wall insulation? How to tell if it's the cause](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/cavity-wall-insulation-damp.html): how to tell whether damp on outside walls is caused by cavity wall insulation, the other causes to rule out first, CIGA guarantees, and when extraction is and isn't needed
- [Will a dehumidifier fix damp? What it can and can't do](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/dehumidifier-for-damp.html): when a dehumidifier helps with condensation, mould and drying out, why it won't fix rising or penetrating damp, and desiccant vs compressor models
- [Woodworm holes: is it active, or just old damage?](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/woodworm-active-or-old.html): how to tell active woodworm from old exit holes, a simple check homeowners can do, and when treatment is and isn't needed
- [Damp cellar: is it normal, and do you need tanking?](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-cellar-tanking-or-membrane.html): why older cellars are damp, what is normal, quick checks, and the difference between tanking (BS 8102 Type A) and cavity drain membranes (Type C)
- [Private tenant with damp and mould? Your rights if the landlord won't fix it](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/private-tenant-damp-mould-rights.html): what private tenants in England can do about damp and mould now, whether Awaab's Law applies yet, and the steps to get a landlord to fix it
- [Damp in an old stone cottage? Why cement and plastic paint often make it worse](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-stone-cottage-cement-render-lime.html): why solid stone walls get damp after cement pointing, render, gypsum plaster or plastic paint, what homeowners can check, and what usually fixes it
- [Has my damp-proof course failed? Why it's often just bridged](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/has-my-damp-proof-course-failed.html): how to tell a failed damp-proof course from a bridged one, what homeowners can check themselves, and when injection is and isn't needed
- [Dry rot or wet rot? How to tell the difference](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/dry-rot-or-wet-rot.html): how to tell dry rot from wet rot, why moisture is always the cause, and how each is repaired
- [Damp patch after heavy rain? It's probably penetrating damp](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-patch-after-heavy-rain.html): why damp patches appear after heavy rain, the usual causes in North East homes, what to check yourself and when to get a survey
- [Damp on your homebuyer survey? What to do next](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/damp-on-homebuyer-survey.html): what it means when a homebuyer survey or mortgage valuation flags damp, what to do before exchange, and how to avoid cowboy quotes
- [Awaab's Law phase two: what changes on 30 November](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/awaabs-law-phase-two-damp-cold-homes.html): what phase two adds, the deadlines for social landlords, and what it means for damp, mould and cold homes
- [Black mould in winter: condensation or rising damp?](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/black-mould-condensation-or-rising-damp.html): how to tell condensation from rising damp and what to do about each
